narration: One more. The common mistake is reading the air number and stopping there. Four degrees means nothing.
caption: एक और बात। आम ग़लती है हवा का नंबर पढ़कर वहीं रुक जाना।
image_brief: A white louvred weather screen standing in the middle of a frosted field at dawn, thick frost around its legs, the slatted box itself clean and dry.

narration: That number was measured inside a box designed to ignore the sky. Your plants were not.
caption: वह नंबर उस बक्से में नापा गया जो आसमान को नज़रअंदाज़ करता है। पौधे नहीं करते।
image_brief: A row of frost-blackened bean leaves drooping in a vegetable plot in mid-morning light, pale soil below, the far end of the plot untouched and green.

narration: And the pan must not touch warm ground. Straw underneath is not decoration. It is essential.
caption: और तवा गर्म ज़मीन से नहीं छूना चाहिए। नीचे का पुआल सजावट नहीं, ज़रूरी है।
image_brief: One clay pan resting directly on bare damp soil beside a second pan resting on a thick straw pad, ice only in the straw-bedded pan.

narration: So go back to the desert. Nothing in that yard was ever refrigerated. Nothing was cooled.
caption: अब उस रेगिस्तान पर लौटो। उस अहाते में कुछ भी ठंडा नहीं किया गया था।
image_brief: A high mud-wall enclosure in the desert at dawn, long shallow trenches inside it, a stack of clay pans by the doorway, no machinery anywhere.

narration: The air never dropped to freezing. The cold did not come from the air. It never does.
caption: हवा कभी जमाव बिंदु तक नहीं गिरी। ठंडक हवा से नहीं आई थी।
image_brief: A sand dune ridge at sunrise with a thin crust of frost along its shaded face and loose warm sand on the lit side.

narration: The heat simply left, through a five micrometre gap, and never came back. One way only.
caption: गर्मी सिर्फ़ पाँच माइक्रोमीटर की दरार से निकल गई और कभी वापस नहीं आई।
image_brief: A narrow slit window high in a thick stone wall, daylight coming through it as a single bright band across a dark stone floor.

narration: They did not make cold. They gave heat a route out. Different idea entirely. That is the trick.
caption: उन्होंने ठंड नहीं बनाई। उन्होंने गर्मी को बाहर का रास्ता दिया। बात ही अलग है।
image_brief: An open stone drain channel running out of a courtyard beneath a low arch, water flowing steadily away into darkness past the wall.

narration: And that route is above your head right now, every clear night. Always open. Free of charge.
caption: और वह रास्ता अभी आपके सिर के ऊपर है, हर साफ़ रात। हमेशा खुला।
image_brief: A view straight upward from the floor of an open desert courtyard at night, the walls framing the edges and a dense field of stars filling the centre.

narration: Your car roof finds it first because it is thin and faces straight up. So does grass.
caption: कार की छत उसे पहले पाती है क्योंकि वह पतली है और सीधे ऊपर देखती है।
image_brief: The bonnet and roof of a hatchback at sunrise with frost only on the flat upward panels, the windscreen clear and the side doors dark.

narration: The road never will. It is holding hands with the whole warm earth. That is the difference.
caption: सड़क कभी नहीं पाएगी। वह पूरी गर्म ज़मीन से हाथ मिलाकर बैठी है।
image_brief: A long stretch of asphalt road at dawn with faint mist lifting off it, thick frost lying on the grass banks along both sides.

narration: Frost is not proof the air froze. It is proof the sky was open. Read it that way.
caption: पाला यह सबूत नहीं कि हवा जमी थी। यह सबूत है कि आसमान खुला था।
image_brief: A frosted wooden garden table at dawn with one clean unfrosted rectangle in the middle where a tray sat overnight.

narration: Engineers now build surfaces tuned to that window, to cool buildings with no power. Same physics.
caption: अब इंजीनियर उसी खिड़की के हिसाब से सतहें बनाते हैं, बिजली के बिना ठंडक के लिए।
image_brief: A flat white-coated industrial roof in bright daylight, the coating brilliant and clean, dark ducting running along one edge.

narration: A village with straw and clay found it first. Same window. No electricity. Just geometry.
caption: पुआल और मिट्टी वाले गाँव ने यह पहले खोज लिया। वही खिड़की। बिजली नहीं।
image_brief: A stack of unglazed clay pans and a bale of straw leaning against a mud-brick wall in strong afternoon sun.

narration: Tonight, if the sky is clear, leave a saucer of water on a folded towel outside.
caption: आज रात आसमान साफ़ हो तो पानी की एक तश्तरी मोड़े तौलिये पर बाहर रखिए।
image_brief: A white saucer of water sitting on a folded towel on an outdoor table in a dark garden, stars overhead, nothing else on the table.

narration: At dawn, check the saucer and the ground beside it. Then check your car roof. The difference is the answer.
caption: सुबह तश्तरी और उसके पास की ज़मीन देखिए। फिर कार की छत देखिए।
image_brief: The same saucer at dawn holding a thin disc of ice, the towel beneath it dry, the table surface around it lightly frosted.
